For each target platform, use SHA-256 ordered frames to choose at most eight with a unique annotated reference proxy and an opposite-side annotation of the same category as the original subject. Add at most four from the remaining single-predicate frames before viewing. Interleave categories privately. Display RGB, both controlled clauses from the same entity spans, and the annotation inventory only. Independent referent/left/right judgments must name a visible unique 3D annotation on each side and must identify the original subject on its labelled side. Keep all other statuses as ambiguous, unannotated, no-opposite, or inconsistent. The geometry/category filter enriches opportunities and does not enter prediction or make any of these a blind population estimate.
